name: project
postCreateCommand: CODEX_HOME="/home/dev/.codex"; mkdir -p "$CODEX_HOME/skills"; if ! touch "$CODEX_HOME/.write-test" 2>/dev/null; then echo "Codex directory is not writable: $CODEX_HOME" >&2; echo "Check the codex-home Docker volume ownership or recreate the volume for this project." >&2; exit 1; fi; rm -f "$CODEX_HOME/.write-test"; if [ -d "$CODEX_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills/.git" ]; then git -C "$CODEX_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills" pull --ff-only; elif [ ! -e "$CODEX_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills" ]; then git clone https://github.com/fmarslan/ai-skills "$CODEX_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills"; else echo "Codex skills path exists but is not a git checkout: $CODEX_HOME/skills/fmarslan-ai-skills"; fi
